**Everbright Prima Homestay Sdn. Bhd. – Company Snapshot** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Registration No.** | SYN‑001389 | | **Incorporated** | 12 Dec 2013 (Selangor) | | **Status** | Active – Private Limited Company | | **Industry / Business** | Hospitality – operates a boutique hotel in Penang | | **Share Capital** | RM 100,000 | | **Directors (as of 2025)** | • Managing Director – Director 1 (appointed 29 Jan 2025)
• Director 2 (appointed 19 Aug 2014)
• Executive Director – Director 3 (appointed 18 Feb 2023)
• Independent Director – Director 4 (appointed 27 May 2015)
• Director 5 (appointed 17 Jun 2021) | | **Shareholder Structure** | • Director 3 – 87.78 % (individual)
• Director 5 – 10.46 %
• Director 1 – 1.76 % | | **Key Financial Highlights** (FY ending 30 Sept) | **Revenue** grew from RM 30.8 M (2022) → RM 42.1 M (2023) → RM 59.1 M (2024).
**Profitability** – Gross margin stayed strong (≈55‑64 %); net profit margin improved from 4.4 % (2022) to 6.8 % (2024).
**EBITDA** rose from RM 4.12 M (2022) to RM 9.77 M (2024).
**Liquidity** – Quick ratio moved from 1.38 (2022) to 1.03 (2024); cash‑to‑revenue rose sharply to 12.5 % in 2024.
**Leverage** – Debt‑to‑equity increased (Leverage ratio 1.46 → 2.50), but interest coverage remained healthy (≈3.5‑4.8×). | | **Cash Flow** | Operating cash flow turned positive each year, reaching RM 7.64 M in 2024; free cash flow in 2024 was RM 6.03 M. | | **Litigation Overview** | • 8 cases recorded (2021‑2025).
• Types: winding‑up petitions, tenancy disputes, debt recovery, breach of contract.
• Current status: 2 pending (tenancy disputes, 2025), 1 pending winding‑up petition (2024), 5 withdrawn or settled.
• Total claim amounts involved ≈ RM 2.5 M (pending/withdrawn). | | **Overall Assessment** | Everbright Prima Homestay has shown robust top‑line growth and improving profitability while expanding its asset base. Liquidity is adequate, though leverage has risen as the company finances growth. The litigation exposure is modest, with most matters resolved or withdrawn, but a few tenancy disputes remain pending. The firm appears financially sound and well‑positioned to continue scaling its boutique‑hotel operations in Penang. |
